MountMoonRivalTextBefore:
It's been a while,
{PLAYER}.

…Since I lost to
you, I thought

about what I was
lacking with my #MON…

And we came up
with an answer.

{PLAYER}, now we'll
show you!
MountMoonRivalTextWin:
I thought I raised
my #MON to be

the best they
could be…

…But it still 
wasn't enough…
MountMoonRivalTextAfter:
…You won, fair
and square.

I admit it. But
this isn't the end.

I'm going to be
the greatest #- MON trainer ever.

Because these guys
are behind me.

…Listen, {PLAYER}.

One of these days
I'm going to prove

how good I am by
beating you.
MountMoonRivalTextLoss:
I've repaid my
debt to you.

With my #MON,
I'm going to beat

the CHAMPION and
become the world's greatest trainer.
